int permutations(string prefix, int count)
    if #prefix == 4
        count += 1
        println("{count}: {prefix}")
        return count
    alphabet := "ABCD"
    for: i < 4
        if not prefix.contains(alphabet[i])
            count = permutations(prefix + alphabet[i], count)
    return count
count := permutations("", 0)
